newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain leaves key rate unchanged at 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain leaves key rate unchanged at 6 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Spain said it left its key money rate unchanged at 6.0 percent at Tuesday's regular repurchase tender for central bank certificates.
It allotted 3.171 trillion pesetas ($22.3 billion) against 3.215 trillion bid.
The Bank of Spain last cut its key money market rate on January 16 by 0.25 basis points to 6.0 percent. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340 ($ = 142.0 Spanish Pesetas)
